recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5426 unless FM chooses to revisit the later CoverageEligibilityRequest scope established by subsequent published issues.
issue_request: FHIR-5426 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request from the Jan 2015 DSTU1 ballot against EligibilityRequest. The ballot comment said the existing resource definition was tautological and needed to explain eligibility; later issue comments suggested describing patient and insurance coverage information sent to an insurer so an EligibilityResponse can report whether coverage is valid and in-force and provide policy details.
initial_application: No FHIR-5426-keyed source commit was found. The old EligibilityRequest introduction already carried clarified non-tautological wording when Eligibility was renamed to EligibilityRequest in 094947bbb81, and commit 15de009ec2 later replaced the spreadsheet root definition's tautological wording with the suggested patient/coverage/insurer response wording.
additional_context: EligibilityRequest is no longer an active current-build resource. source/fhir.ini actively lists coverageeligibilityrequest=CoverageEligibilityRequest, comments out the old EligibilityRequest TLA entry, and maps CoverageEligibilityRequest back to EligibilityRequest in the name-change map. FHIR-16936 later renamed EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse to CoverageEligibilityRequest/CoverageEligibilityResponse, and FHIR-17473 later broadened CoverageEligibilityRequest scope to validation, discovery, benefits, and preauthorization requirements. Both later decisions are already represented on the combined branch. Current CoverageEligibilityRequest introduction and StructureDefinition text are non-tautological and broader than the 2015 clarification.
reconciliation: Made no source change. Editing the retained source/eligibilityrequest files would affect out-of-build historical residue, while changing the active CoverageEligibilityRequest wording would either duplicate or weaken later approved FM scope wording that already explains eligibility and coverage-requirements use.

related_jiras.note: Renamed EligibilityRequest and EligibilityResponse to CoverageEligibilityRequest and CoverageEligibilityResponse, establishing the current active artifact for this older issue.
